title: SunoMediaRow, regular (vs the Volume mixer's playing block)
about: SunoMediaRow at regular density, alone in its window, against the first playing block of the published Volume mixer reference (Design Center mockups/sound-mixer/settings.html .mxch). The reference's page is set to the simulator's 680 px and its transport keys are named as the row's are.

before.eval: (() => { if (matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches) document.documentElement.dataset.mode = 'light'; const page = document.querySelector('.cfpage'); page.style.boxSizing = 'border-box'; page.style.width = '680px'; const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mxch')[0].querySelectorAll('.mxctl button')]; b[0].setAttribute('aria-label', 'Previous'); b[1].setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause'); b[2].setAttribute('aria-label', 'Next'); })()

states.name: playing
states.about: A song playing at full volume on the main output
